## Why this matters
PR #253 was merged to `main` on 2026-06-14 without closing its R81 audit findings. This issue tracks the outstanding follow-up work. Feature is behind `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_MWB_UNDO` (default-OFF) so there is no production blast radius today, but the PR is not R81-clean and cannot be flag-flipped until findings are closed.

## What's required
- [ ] **F1 (P1)** D7B canonical delete-set absent — `deletedKeysRef`/`deletedSignaturesRef` live in `CoachWorkoutBuilderScreen` and `applyInverse → addExercise` re-adds with fresh `clientId` without clearing delete markers — `src/screens/coach/CoachWorkoutBuilderScreen.tsx:337-417,1333-1356` — fix: implement D7B canonical delete-set abstraction; clear/consume delete intent on undo restore
- [ ] **N1 (P1)** `addExercise` undo silently no-ops after server-id adoption remaps `clientId` — `src/screens/coach/CoachWorkoutBuilderScreen.tsx:364-390`; `src/__tests__/coachWorkoutBuilderAutosave.test.tsx:981-1045` — fix: preserve original `clientId` across post-insert adoption; seed `rowIdToClientIdRef.current.set(adoptedId, oldClientId)` before full replace; add regression test for add-then-adopt-then-undo
- [ ] **F2 (P2)** Missing D7B/undo integration pins — remove-then-undo/adoption, reorder-undo, exercise-field-undo not covered — `src/__tests__/coachWorkoutBuilderAutosave.test.tsx:981-1118` — fix: add integration pins for those paths and no-op inverse detection
- [ ] **F3 (P2)** Undo toast not announced to accessibility — `CoachWorkoutBuilderScreen.tsx:1482-1490` (toast `<View>` has no `accessibilityLiveRegion`, `accessibilityRole="status"`, or `AccessibilityInfo.announceForAccessibility`) — fix: add live-region/status accessibility to the undo toast and pin it
- [ ] **N2 (P2)** Undo action pushes happen inside React state updater functions — `moveRow`, `removeRow`, `updateRow` all call `pushUndoActionRef` from inside `setRows(...)` updaters — `src/screens/coach/CoachWorkoutBuilderScreen.tsx:394-407,419-456,462-480` — fix: compute command action before calling `setRows`; no command-stack push or delete-set mutation inside a React state updater
- [ ] **N3 (P2)** No undo invocation/failure/overflow telemetry — `src/screens/coach/CoachWorkoutBuilderScreen.tsx:1416-1424`; `src/hooks/useBuilderCommandStack.ts:250-258,276-288` — fix: add typed analytics events (`mwb_undo_invoked`, `mwb_undo_failed`, `mwb_undo_stack_evicted`) with non-PII props; emit overflow; pin event constants
- [ ] **F4 (P3)** `applyInverse` empty dependency array is fragile while reading refs/helpers and setters — `src/screens/coach/CoachWorkoutBuilderScreen.tsx:1315-1392` — fix: document and/or correct the `useCallback` dependency-array contract
- [ ] **F5 (P3)** Toast passes `commandCapacity` (stack capacity), not remaining depth — `src/screens/coach/CoachWorkoutBuilderScreen.tsx:1394-1424` — fix: pass remaining stack depth to `romanBuilderUndoToast.success` so copy is accurate
- [ ] **F6 (P3)** `UndoButton` docstring says `textMuted` for the divider but implementation uses `sc.border` — `src/components/coach/workout-builder/UndoButton.tsx:17-19,121-126` — fix: correct the docstring to match the implementation

## Already resolved
Pre-merge audit + post-merge re-audit complete. Findings list above is verified against current `main`.
